question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in blank 2.
solution:
The correct answer is Overnight.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• Tonight- On the present or approaching evening or night.
 
• Overnight- For the duration of a night. 
 
• Every night- At the end of each day. 
 
• At night- During the time when it is dark and is before midnight.
 
 
 
• Hence, 'overnight' is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• Thus option 2 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: *The rise and fall of singers, music videos with lavish production budgets that amass hundreds of millions of views on YouTube, new sensations born virtually overnight the overhang of drugs, guns and violence, and the thrill of taste-making can all get overwhelming.*
